description: Fork of exp685 (1.4438 @ 110M, dual-stream E=96 d_v=16). Single change: d_v 16 -> 32 (breaks the H*d_v = E symmetry; now H*d_v=192=2*E). Tests if wider attention values help when E is small. v_lut per layer: 6*512*64*32 = 6.29M (was 3.15M, +3.15M/L = +18.9M total). out_proj input_dim grows 96 -> 192 (H*d_v), but n_out=E=96 unchanged so out_proj params unchanged. Total ~129M (vs exp685 110M, +19M). References: exp685 = 1.4438 @ 110M (E=96, d_v=16, symmetric), exp684 = 1.4262 @ 140M (E=144, d_v=24), exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (<100M SOTA).
